in_marathi.name: Lavitha
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lavitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Lavana' meaning 'light' or 'illumination'. This name carries the essence of enlightenment and wisdom. In Hindu mythology, Lavitha is often associated with Goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth and prosperity.
